title: Annual vs monthly billing — Pricing glossary
desc: The choice between paying month-to-month or prepaying a year, usually for a discount. Annual billing trades commitment for a lower effective rate.

title: API access and integrations — Pricing glossary
desc: An API lets software talk to your other tools programmatically; integrations are pre-built connections. Both determine whether the tool fits the stack…

title: Contract term and auto-renewal — Pricing glossary
desc: The length of your commitment and what happens when it ends — many B2B contracts auto-renew for another full term unless you cancel inside a notice window.

title: Data migration — Pricing glossary
desc: Moving your existing data — customers, transactions, history — into the new tool. The most underestimated cost in any software switch.

title: Free trial — Pricing glossary
desc: A time-limited period of full or nearly-full access before you pay. The honest way to evaluate software — if you use it properly.

title: Freemium — Pricing glossary
desc: A free tier that is genuinely useful, with paid upgrades for power features. The vendor bets you will grow into paying.

title: Multi-currency billing — Pricing glossary
desc: Whether the vendor bills and operates in your currency — and what happens when it does not. List-price currency and billing currency are different…

title: Onboarding fee — Pricing glossary
desc: A one-time charge for setup, data migration, or training when you start. Sometimes waived, sometimes mandatory, sometimes disguised as implementation.

title: Per-transaction fee — Pricing glossary
desc: A fee charged on each sale or payment processed — typically a small percentage plus a fixed amount. The core of payment-processor pricing.

title: Price lock and grandfathering — Pricing glossary
desc: Grandfathering means existing customers keep their old price when rates rise; a price lock is a contractual guarantee the price will not change for a set…

title: SaaS — Pricing glossary
desc: Software you rent by subscription and use in a browser instead of buying once and installing. You pay for access, and the vendor handles hosting,…

title: Seat-based pricing — Pricing glossary
desc: A pricing model where you pay per user login, sometimes called per-seat or per-user pricing. Adding a team member raises the bill; removing one lowers it.

title: Service-level agreement — Pricing glossary
desc: A service-level agreement (SLA) is the vendor's contractual promise about uptime and support response times, plus what you receive if they miss. Standard…

title: Tiered pricing — Pricing glossary
desc: Plans stacked in levels — Starter, Pro, Enterprise — where each tier unlocks more features, higher limits, or better support. Most B2B software is sold…

title: Usage-based pricing — Pricing glossary
desc: Pricing tied to how much you use — transactions processed, emails sent, API calls made — rather than a flat fee. The bill scales with your activity.
